title: How the Guide works
summary: The Guide explains worfy in short Topics: a diagram, a few lines of text and, folded below, how the Feature is built in code.
Open it from Help ▸ worfy Guide or from the Command palette. It needs no Project and no network, and it never opens by itself.

scene.description: Help ▸ worfy Guide and a row of the Command palette both open the Guide. The Guide reads each Topic from its folder in the app's own code: the texts in English and Russian and the diagram.

labels.topicsNote: texts EN, RU and a diagram
labels.step1: Help ▸ worfy Guide opens the Guide where it was left.
labels.step2: A row of the Command palette opens the Guide at its Topic.
labels.step3: The Guide reads the Topic from its folder: the texts in both languages and this diagram.

text: The Guide is a dialog over the window. Its code is a separate chunk that loads the first time the Guide opens, so starting worfy does not pay for it.

Each Topic keeps its text in two JSON files, one per language, next to its diagram. A test fails when a string has only one of its two versions. The language switch is saved in the app settings of this Machine.

files.src/renderer/guide/GuideWindow.tsx: The window: the list of Topics, the Topic, the language switch
files.src/renderer/guide/registry.ts: One line per Topic, for the Command palette
files.scripts/guide-lag.mjs: The report of Topics behind their pages or their translation

limits: This test Topic is not shown in a packaged build.
